description.narrative:
The Education for Active Citizenship (EfAC) program and with a focus on Alternative and Transformative Education for Girls. In Mozambique, the project is being implemented at the level of Zambezia province, through strategic partnerships with Civil Society organizations, and in the current 2024-2025 period, with the Núcleo das Associações Femininas da Zambézia (NAFEZA), and the Associação de Raparigas da Zambézia (ARZ), in 2 districts, namely: Nicoadala and Maganja da Costa, and in coordination with relevant state institutions such as the Ministry of Education and Human Development (MINEDH) at all levels, from Zambezia Provincial Directorate of Education (DPEZ), District Services of Education Youth and Technology (SDEJT), Zone of Pedagogical Influence (ZIP) and school. The projectis currently being funded by Oxfam Hong Kong since 2022, and is contributing to improving access to and completion of a transformative and equitable education for girls and other vulnerable children in Mozambique and the Southern African region. Named “Diverse groups of women, girls and the marginalized fully realize their rights, exercise their leadership and live a life free of violence, discrimination and poverty”, it will continue its focus on gender transformation and inclusion for adolescents and young people, with an emphasis on empowering girls both in and out of school, through the implementation of transformative education approaches “Girls'Clubs”, an approach to empowering pupils and developing complementary teaching and learning activities that promote life skills andthat are framed within the activities of the Circles of Interest and actions of a transversal nature, such as gender equity and equality and the promotion of human rights for children and young peopleof both sexes.
NAFEZA- Zambézia Women's Associations Nucleusisa network that brings together about 67 Associations in Zambezia Province. It was created in 1997, with a vision of gender equalityand social justice so that women have a dignified life with autonomy and freedom of choice. Since its inception, the Network has accumulated extensive work experience in promoting the rights of women and girls and in gender-based violence issues, which through mobilization actions through community dialogues, traditional and administrative leadership and, together with women, Men, girls and boys of different ages on conceptions of gender, gender-based violence, types of forms of violence, and on denunciation. is this project, the organisation will train activist to work with adolescent girls from school and communities in order to improve the participation of girls at school.

participating-org.narrative: NAFEZA (Núcleo das Associações Femininas da Zambézia) is a Mozambican network organisation of women's organisations in Zambezia province. NAFEZA was founded by three organisations in 1997 and currently has 53 member organisations that work mainly in the areas of gender, prevention of HIV and AIDS, combating gender-based violence and promotion of human rights. NAFEZA is a member of the national network of women's organisations: Forum Mulher, another partner of Oxfam Novib. NAFEZA aims to be a strong network and represent civil society organisations to ensure the empowerment of women. The main objectives of NAFEZA are to reduce gender inequality and to improve the status of women through co-ordination and strengthening of civil society organisations in Zambezia province; to promote access to information, training and education of women; and to put pressure on government to adopt and implement measure for gender equality and women#s empowerment in their policies and programs.
